answer.rationale: Finance demands 18% cost cut; incumbent refuses to renegotiate this cycle. Memory c2 records a successful switch to a low-cost vendor with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing. Pulling c2 verifies the onboarding speed and reliability claims that are critical given the 14-day expiry window and 94% line utilization with no buffer. If the archived record confirms low switching friction, we execute the switch to hit the cost target without adding delivery risk; if it reveals hidden onboarding costs or timeline risk, we fall back to renew_incumbent to preserve continuity and revisit cost via negotiate_terms next cycle.
